analysis.title_zh: HiRO-ACEv2：以较低成本生成全球3公里分辨率气候数据
analysis.summary: 公告介绍了气候模拟系统HiRO-ACEv2：ACE先生成100公里分辨率输出，再由HiRO细化至3公里。官方称，HiROv2能够高精度再现极罕见的降雨、风和气压事件，完整系统生成全球3公里气候数据的成本约为X-SHiELD的1/300，可用于极端天气与高分辨率气候研究。所给原文在介绍最大变化时截断，未提供具体技术改动或验证细节。
analysis.application: 建议：科研迁移可考虑将其气候输出用于基础设施极端天气暴露、结构环境荷载及可靠性研究，但需另行验证局地偏差与工程适用性。官方报告的效果限于罕见天气事件再现能力及气候数据生成成本，不能据此认定其已验证智能运维或结构设计效果。
evidence: We introduce HiRO-ACEv2 , the newest update to our High Resolution Output Ai2 Climate Emulator (HiRO-ACE) system.

HiROv2 can reproduce even extremely rare rain, wind, and pressure events with high accuracy, while the full system can generate global 3 km climate data at about 1/300th the cost of X-SHiELD, a high-resolution global atmospheric model that explicitly simulates storms and other small-scale weather.
HiRO-ACE, introduced earlier in 2026 , has two parts: ACE, an AI model that operates at a coarser 100 km resolution, and HiRO, a model that sharpens those coarse outputs into fine 3 km detail.
